periods.label: 猎人与落第骑士的再战
titles: 去年七星剑武祭代表选手

status.reputation: previously undefeated without injury in school matches

appearance.overview: Handsome student with many female admirers.

personality.summary: Cowardly underneath a polished, sadistic hunter persona; attacks only when sure of advantage.
fears: direct confrontation after his advantage fails
personality.inner_conflict: His superiority depends on never being forced into an equal fight.

decision_pattern.combat: hide, snipe, injure nonlethally to toy with prey; forfeits against opponents who counter his range-wide stealth

mannerisms: tells opponents where he claims he will shoot
habits.daily_routine: Surrounded by female fans before his defeat.
quirks: forfeits matches he cannot safely win

formative_events: As first-year top student, qualified for Seven Stars but forfeited against a bad matchup
participated in bullying Ikki under the former administration
background.pre_story: Shot Ikki repeatedly in an unofficial challenge while teachers watched and only received a warning.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Former classmate, bullying target, and eventual opponent who defeats him.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Tries to make her his girlfriend through a wager on Ikki's match.
relationships.fan-girls: Female admirers who abandon him after his cowardly collapse.

secrets: His courage fails once an opponent closes in and he fears being cut.
periods.summary: Kirihara is introduced after the mall incident as a former classmate who once tormented Ikki. He bets with Stella before facing Ikki in the selection battle. His upgraded Hunter's Forest hides both body and arrows, letting him brutally snipe Ikki while stirring the crowd against him. Once Ikki achieves Perfect Vision and reads his actions, Kirihara panics, begs to stop, and loses without serious injury.

key_events.summary: Mocks Ikki and wagers Stella will be his girlfriend if Ikki loses.
Dominates with invisible arrows until Ikki reads and defeats him.
